description: Defines the scrambling_metrics_aggregator class, which aggregates metrics related to pseudo-random sequence generation, including timing, bit counts, and rates.

classes.name: scrambling_metrics_aggregator
classes.description: A class that aggregates metrics for a pseudo-random sequence generator, tracking timing, bit counts, and rates.

methods.name: get_average_init_time_us
methods.description: Returns the average initialization time in microseconds.

methods.name: get_advance_rate_Mbps
methods.description: Returns the average advance rate in Mbps.

methods.name: get_generate_rate_Mbps
methods.description: Returns the average generation rate in Mbps.

methods.name: get_total_time
methods.description: Returns the total time spent by the scrambler as a duration.

methods.name: get_cpu_usage_us
methods.description: Returns the total CPU usage in microseconds for scrambling operations.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all internal counters and accumulated metrics.
